from collections import defaultdict
def blobify(pts, cell=4):
    grid=defaultdict(list)
    for x,y in pts:
        grid[(x//cell,y//cell)].append((x,y))
    occ=set(grid)
    seen=set()
    blobs=[]
    for s in occ:
        if s in seen: continue
        st=[s]; seen.add(s); comp=[]
        while st:
            c=st.pop(); comp.append(c)
            cx,cy=c
            for dx in (-1,0,1):
                for dy in (-1,0,1):
                    n=(cx+dx,cy+dy)
                    if n in occ and n not in seen:
                        seen.add(n); st.append(n)
        pix=[]
        for c in comp:
            pix.extend(grid[c])
        ax=sum(p[0] for p in pix)/len(pix)
        ay=sum(p[1] for p in pix)/len(pix)
        minx=min(p[0] for p in pix); maxx=max(p[0] for p in pix)
        miny=min(p[1] for p in pix); maxy=max(p[1] for p in pix)
        blobs.append((ax,ay,maxx-minx+1,maxy-miny+1,len(pix)))
    return blobs
